scheme_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a domicile of Maharashtra State
Applicant must be a bonafide student admitted to a professional or technical course (Diploma, Graduation, Post‑Graduation)
Deemed universities and private universities are not eligible
Admission must be through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP)
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend
Only two children from the same family are eligible in the current academic year
Minimum 50 % attendance in the previous semester (except for fresh admissions)
The candidate must not have a gap of two years or more during the course duration
benefits_summary: Provides a hostel maintenance allowance of Rs 3,000 per year (Rs 20,000 for children of Aplabhudharak shetkari/registered labourers) for eligible students with family income ≤ 8 Lakhs, with amounts varying by location.
